title: Bare electron dispersion from photoemission experiments
abstract: Performing an in-depth analysis of the photoemission spectra along the nodal direction of the high temperature superconductor Bi-2212 we have developed a procedure to determine the underlying electronic structure and established a precise relation of the measured quantities to the real and imaginary parts of the self-energy of electronic excitations. The self-consistency of the procedure with respect to the Kramers-Kronig transformation allows us to draw conclusions on the applicability of the spectral function analysis and on the existence of well defined quasiparticles along the nodal direction even for the underdoped Bi-2212 in the pseudogap state.
